LOOK_AT.say: A young man behind a counter, in a coat that has been brushed a great deal more often than it has been cleaned.
repeat: He is twenty-two at the outside and he has the manner of a man defending an institution.
He has not once looked at the door. Nobody is coming through it and he knows the timetable.

LISTEN_TO.say: A pen. He is writing something that is not the register.
repeat: Nothing. He has stopped, and he is waiting for me to go so that he can start again.

options.text: Thaddeus Grubb. Two B's and no E, if you're writing it down.

exchange.speaker: thad
exchange.line: That has an E in it.

options.say: The register is mine. The building is a formality.

options.text: I'd like your finest room, please.
options.repeat: Still five. The price doesn't have feelings either.
Four dollars, no room. Still compatible.
options.say: Then you have four dollars and no room. Those are compatible.
options.echo: I have four. Could four be persuaded?

options.text: Your piano is out of tune, you know.
options.repeat: The piano first, Mr. Grubbe. Then nineteen.
options.echo: Your piano is out of tune, you know. A quarter-tone, at least.

options.repeat: The road, as given. It keeps no register, which is its only appeal.
